user.title: LLM Toolbox
user.description: Adds extra tools to the Assist LLM API: climate modes, select options, sensor history, weather forecasts, notifications, calendar event creation and media sources. Every conversation agent that uses the Assist API can call them. Tools only show up for entities exposed to Assist. Pick the tools to enable; you can change them later with Configure.

init.title: LLM Toolbox
init.description: Tools that LLM Toolbox adds to the Assist LLM API. Each one is only offered when matching entities are exposed to Assist.

options.select_option: Change select options (vacuum mop mode, appliance programs)
options.media_source: Play on a specific speaker (media player source)
